Second sneak peek! This is Alanis Christian, one of our brilliant young visual artists who currently studies social anthropology at university. You can view her beautiful Uganda inspired work on Saturday 7th July at #TYPify2018. Get your tix today!

Next up we have the crazy talented , a performer/writer/director studying at Middlesex Uni. Toby's play #Pothole was at #TYPify2017 & our #TYPeItUp scheme, and this year he's back with a brand new one-man piece, #Block. We LOVE his titles!!

We are delighted to introduce you all to Jade Pughe, ! Jade, 19, is a Graphic Designer & Illustrator. Her style consists of illustrations and eye-catching colours which are created by hand using analogue techniques. She's off to Central Saint Martins in September!

We're thrilled to have Zoe Christian's work at #TYPify2018, especially as she's moved all the way across the pond and made Devon her new home! "Through all of my travels, art has always been my constant. My artwork is my safe haven, and I hope it provides a moment of reflection."
